ingestion.text: Real-time ingestion of broker and reinsurance traffic is handled via secure APIs, maintaining backward compatibility for legacy SOAP interfaces. External lookups for vehicle registry and credit screening are executed synchronously during underwriting processes.

transactional_storage.validation_reason: Assumes successful conversion of legacy Oracle PL/SQL logic to the target relational database engine.
transactional_storage.text: Core policy transactions and operational data are stored in a highly available relational database. This database replaces the legacy on-premises database and supports high-concurrency policy administration operations.

analytical_storage.text: Operational data is extracted nightly and transferred to the corporate data warehouse. This ensures analytical workloads are decoupled from the transactional database to preserve daytime performance.

quality.validation_reason: Specific data quality rules and validation frameworks need to be defined with the business stakeholders.
quality.text: Data quality is enforced at the entry point through API schema validation and real-time integration checks. External registry lookups validate vehicle and policyholder details before committing transactions.

metadata_governance.text: Metadata and data lineage are governed to comply with Norwegian FSA and DORA regulations. Immutable audit logs track every policy state mutation to ensure complete traceability.

retention.validation_reason: Retention periods for non-audit policy data and document assets must be defined.
retention.text: Policy audit trails are retained in immutable storage for a mandatory period of 10 years. Retention policies for core policy documents and transactional history must be validated to align with local insurance laws.

privacy_security.text: All personal data is strictly confined to EU/EEA borders to comply with GDPR and local regulations. Data in transit is secured using modern transport security, and legacy broker interfaces are protected using WS-Security with X.509 tokens.

reporting_analytics.text: Reporting is supported by exporting nightly operational data feeds to the corporate data warehouse. This allows complex business intelligence queries to run without impacting the transactional system.

backup_recovery.text: The transactional database is configured with continuous replication to meet a 15-minute recovery point objective. Disaster recovery procedures are automated to guarantee a recovery time objective of under 4 hours.
